rows.operation: Each register’s disclosure is an account answerable to its source and its own standing; routing must return a claim to its governing Argument rather than turn the route into another theorem.
A local Bimba can govern reference within a bounded inquiry while remaining source-dependent and revisable within a wider frame. The account’s correction can reach that local reference itself.
An inspectable lens and gauge explain how a judgment arose without making the framework its ontological source. Returned consequence must be able to change the selected mediation.
The exposed judgment field makes actual conditioning inspectable. Its resulting account retains its scope when reused as input, and cannot claim the whole world through that reuse.
The inspected obligation and the act of entrusting remain distinct; reliance can continue through investigation, correction and refusal without requiring possession of its ground.
A record can receive contrary evidence while protecting its criterion. Return must reach that criterion and the office holding it, so added disclosure can change the account’s terms.
The criterion remains visible in the result, allowing a disputed comparison to return to its denominator without losing the calculation’s earned exactness.
A chart carries its conditions and the limits of transition to another chart. Returned obstruction can change the comparison rather than be hidden by accumulating more pictures.
The Other’s reply can change the question and terms of approach. A shared whole does not let either participant finish the other’s response on their behalf.
An entrusted office makes authority executable while affected consequence can revise its commission. Reliance needs a bearer able to answer beyond the account’s present evidence.
Fidelity can require changed representation, criterion or commission. The disclosure gives another an address at which objection or refusal can become consequential.
Returned source, resistance or consequence must make a discriminable change in inquiry or action. A retained record alone does not establish that the method performed its return.

The historical matching token figures retained differentiation across separation; its parties and institution retain their own evidence. This qualifies the material comparison while the native divide/relate/recombine/return derivation keeps its own warrant.
The cut retains the common operation and field that produced its terms; a returned objection can reach the criterion which made the division.
The matching seam keeps an achieved sign answerable across separation, and provisional anchors remain able to receive a changed encounter.
Exposing the evaluator’s conditions makes the score inspectable; a named undertaking still bears the consequence of relying upon it.

A bounded Bimba reference field remains inspectable and revisable in its wider context. The harness carries source, gauge, exclusion and consequence so the account’s return can reach its own reference office.
The circulating account changes conditions outside itself. Return can revise a local model, translation, gauge or institution while preserving plural centres and their independent grounds.
